comment: V1 Phase 4 — Linux packaging evidence, built and verified in-sandbox 2026-10-28 (Debian 13, 2 CPU / 2 GB RAM + 4 GB swap, rustc 1.99.1 via rustup, GTK/WebKit dev stack via apt). Windows NSIS/MSI and macOS DMG remain BLOCKED → native CI (desktop-app.yml). Signing/provenance: NOT performed here (owner keys only — DESKTOP_SIGNING.md); these hashes are engineering evidence, not signed release artifacts.

build.notes: First attempt (parallel jobs) was OOM-killed (SIGKILL, signal 9) on the final app crate — codegen-units=1 + opt-level=3 needs >2 GB. Retried single-job with 4 GB swap: SUCCESS.

verified.appimage_extract: PASS — squashfs-root/usr/bin/{xr-desktop, xr-engine} both present (sidecar bundled)

verified.control: Package: xr, Version: 1.1.1-rc.1, Architecture: amd64, Depends: libayatana-appindicator3-1, libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0, libgtk-3-0
verified.install: PASS — sudo dpkg -i on Debian 13 sandbox; dpkg -l xr → ii 1.1.1-rc.1
verified.launch: PASS — xvfb-run: the app process started and stayed up for the full 25 s window (exit 124 = timeout-while-running); only benign headless warnings (appindicator deprecation, no session dbus in sandbox)

honest_limitations: Not a strict clean-OS install: the sandbox already had libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev et al. from the build toolchain (the runtime deps are the same libraries); the true clean-OS matrix remains CI's native job.
No signing, no updater artifacts, no provenance — owner keys only (ledger §3, DESKTOP_SIGNING.md).
rpm target not attempted locally (tauri.conf lists it for CI).
The GUI was driven under Xvfb; visual/interactive verification (menus, tray, shortcuts) needs a real display — owner-side.
